title: Slope-acceleration (second-difference) regime states with forced rebalancing on living vol ETP legs

blindness_declaration.law: D1 outcome-blind proposal: no outcome measurement, no returns conditional on states, no expectancies, no signal arithmetic on prices or indices beyond structural facts already committed in P0/P1/P2 artifacts. Every numeric leaf below is a committed structural fact cited from a sha256-pinned P0/P1/P2 artifact and appears only under committed_citations, representation_identity or feasibility_citation.
blindness_declaration.parameters_symbolic_until: D2/S (frozen before any scored number is seen; no threshold may move after any scored number)

mechanism.narrative: Slope-reversal gravity and the late-chaser lag. When the term-structure slope's own change ACCELERATES -- a second-difference flip: the curve was steepening and starts flattening, or an inversion starts unwinding -- two participant classes are forced simultaneously. Dealers and market-makers in the futures complex must re-hedge the positioning they built for the PREVIOUS slope regime, and ETP creation/redemption flows (plus retail flow) chase the reversal only after it is already established, because ETP share creation mechanically lags the index state. The declared mechanism is that delayed, persistent re-positioning, expressed in the tradeable ETP legs.
mechanism.forced_participant: The slope-regime flip forces the dealer/market-maker book: hedges sized for the prior slope state become wrong-footed at the acceleration and must be re-laid regardless of view. On the liability side it forces the ETP issuer, whose rolling stack must be rebalanced when the curve regime flips, because the roll economics of the held futures change sign.
mechanism.late_participant: Late entrants chasing the slope reversal: ETP creation/redemption and retail flow rotate into the winning segment only after the acceleration is public, arriving after the flip and extending the re-positioning over subsequent sessions -- the lag is the mechanism's footprint.
mechanism.claim_declared_blind: Second-difference (acceleration) states of the slope, gated by a persistence latch, identify regime flips whose forced re-positioning persists beyond the flip date; whether that persistence supports conditioning tradeable ETP legs after the full measured cost ladder is exactly what D2 measures. Nothing is measured now.
mechanism.economic_magnitude_honesty: Declared honestly: forced rebalancing at regime flips multiplies round trips, and the P2 worst-case round-trip cost ceilings at the primary stress tier (cited under feasibility_citation) are on the order of two thousand basis points on the SHORT-bucket legs. Acceleration states must therefore be RARE and PERSISTENT to survive; frequent flips are declared uneconomic a priori and the family dies cheap if flips are common.

decision_rule_family.state_definition_symbolic: S_t = the same symbolic slope functional of same-session VIX9D/VIX/VIX3M closes as the lane's bucket family; D_t = symbolic second difference of S_t (change of the change). STATE_t in {accelerating-steepening, decelerating, accelerating-flattening} with a symbolic persistence latch: a regime is recognised only after it holds m consecutive sessions (m symbolic, frozen at D2/S).
decision_rule_family.action_map_symbolic: Each recognised regime maps to a symbolic position {long short-vol leg, long long-vol leg, flat} on a symbolic subset of the living event-adjusted ETP legs, under a forced minimum-rebalance convention R (symbolic) that forbids churn inside a recognised regime.
decision_rule_family.parameter_law: ALL parameters symbolic until D2/S; frozen before any scored number; no numeric thresholds are declared at D1.
decision_rule_family.arm_law: Arms must respect the frozen rubric cell budget (families x arms bounded, pairwise distinct arm_config_digest); arms sharing a slope functional with VOLNG1-A4-P1 must remain pairwise distinct configurations.

why_information_differs.v16_close_displace_fade: the shadow is a single-instrument close-displacement FADE: first difference of one series, mean-reversion form. This proposal's state is the SECOND difference of a cross-tenor spread -- a different object (curve shape, not a price level) and a different order of differencing -- and the declared claim is persistence of forced flow after a regime flip, the opposite-signed behaviour to a fade. D2 tests the claim at the frozen ancestry margin.
why_information_differs.v17_oi_level: the shadow is a derivative open-interest LEVEL form; the frozen consumption set contains no options chain and no open-interest series (EODHD family-2 explicitly not entitled), so no OI re-clock is possible. D2 tests the claim by ancestry pooling.
why_information_differs.dvol_shock: the shadow is a realized derivative-shock form on a different asset complex; this proposal consumes only official CBOE index closes and event-adjusted ETP closes. D2 tests the claim by ancestry pooling.
why_information_differs.momentum_63s: the shadow is long-horizon single-series price momentum on an instrument level; this proposal's state is a SHORT-memory (second-difference) acceleration of the index curve, not a multi-session NAV trend, and is computed on the index term structure rather than any ETP NAV. The index-only shadow separates index-state information from ETP-NAV behaviour. D2 tests the claim.
why_information_differs.generic_dow_tue: the shadow is a calendar day-of-week effect; the calendar-clock shadow control forces the rule to survive a weekday re-clock and the placebo destroys temporal structure while matching marginals.

ancestry_risk_statement.d2_test_of_claim: pooled ancestry |rho| within the frozen rubric margin against the full pooled inventory INCLUDING every shadow named above; margin recorded per rubric; failure is a D2 VETO, recorded, never argued away.

control_battery_spec.battery_law: the battery must be runnable on the frozen representation with the invalid-null distinction recorded (frozen rubric); the mandatory controls are vetoes, not suggestions (plan section 1 a+b).

index_only_shadow.spec: the identical acceleration-regime rule driven by the vol index series ALONE (VIX9D/VIX/VIX3M closes), placement re-clocked onto the ETP legs, no ETP price anywhere in the state. If the ETP-leg placement is not distinct from its own index re-clock, the ETP leg adds nothing and the proposal dies as an index re-clock.

cost_path_control.spec: the rule must survive the measured path-cost ladder: measured execution spreads scaled through the committed tier ladder (primary tier at the top), cost once per fill, and the Q-16 roll/decay path component carried explicitly at every tier (per-leg path formulas and adverse tails as committed in the frozen cost contract and the P2 gate). Because forced rebalancing multiplies round trips, the ladder is evaluated per placed arm INCLUDING its forced rebalance count; kill before selection if any arm fails.

calendar_clock_shadow.spec: the same rule re-clocked to a fixed weekday shift (symbolic shift k sessions, frozen at D2/S): a generic_dow_tue detector. A placement that survives the re-clock unchanged is a calendar artefact and dies.

placebo.spec: the acceleration-state series is time-shuffled with matched marginals and destroyed temporal ordering (which destroys genuine regime persistence); the placement induced by the placebo must be indistinguishable from chance. A significant differential placement under the placebo kills the proposal.

control_battery_spec.invalid_null_distinction: an uncomputable state (warmup needs two slope observations, refused tail, missing session) is INVALID and refused fail-closed; it is never coerced to NULL/flat and never scored as a decision (Q-11).

feasibility_citation.ceiling_note: worst-case COST CEILINGS at the primary stress tier; bounds, not expectations, not PnL numbers (Q-6 no-PnL law). Declared honestly: forced rebalancing makes the effective cost multiplier worse than a single round trip, so a surviving mechanism must be economically LARGE and regimes must be rare and persistent.

falsification_rule.rule: PREREGISTERED KILL (one concrete condition): at D2, if NO placed arm of this proposal clears its committed per-leg worst-case round-trip cost ceiling after the FULL measured path-cost ladder at the primary stress tier (Q-16 component and forced-rebalance multiplier included) -- equivalently, if every placed arm's after-cost expectancy on the primary NET book on the P2 bookable grid is at or below zero -- this proposal is KILLED and recorded as VOL_NG1_REJECT_ALL evidence. No threshold moves after any scored number is seen.
